page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, utilizing a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.sn2.3xlarge delivers average multi-core performance alongside weaker single-core capabilities. In stress-ng and Geekbench testing, single-core metrics fall into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression registers in the bottom 10%. However, multi-threaded operations, such as bzip3 decompression and software compilation with Clang, achieve average performance tiers. Memory bandwidth tests for both small and large blocks also align with middle-tier performance, as do Passmark CPU and database operation benchmarks.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance represents a standard general-purpose resource profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that require steady, non-burstable CPU resources but do not demand high single-threaded speed. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, multi-threaded data processing, Redis key-value operations, and moderate-scale database operations. It is less suitable for single-threaded tasks or applications requiring local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
